text: v1 预览已生成。像素差异只出现在第三个卖点区域，范围为 x=794–914、y=1045–1221；产品区、主标题区、背景和前两个卖点均与 v0 像素一致。接下来写入 v1 的校验记录，并确认 v0 文件哈希未变化。

command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
import hashlib,json
root=Path('.')

def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def flatten(doc):
  out={}
  for o in doc['root']['children']:
    out[o['id']]=o
    for item in o.get('items',[]): out[item['id']]=item
  return out

v0=json.loads((root/'outputs/v0/design_document.json').read_text())
v1=json.loads((root/'outputs/v1/design_document.json').read_text())
o0,o1=flatten(v0),flatten(v1)
p0=Image.open(root/'outputs/v0/preview.png').convert('RGB')
p1=Image.open(root/'outputs/v1/preview.png').convert('RGB')
d=ImageChops.difference(p0,p1)
allowed=(697,998,1010,1296)
# Clear allowed region from diff; anything left is unintended.
outside=d.copy(); Image.Image.paste(outside,(0,0,0),allowed)

keys_unchanged=['background.paper','background.veil','hero.media_frame','product.photo','headline','headline.accent','feature.timer','footer.rule']
result={
 'v1_preview_sha256':sha('outputs/v1/preview.png'),
 'v1_preview_size':p1.size,
 'diff_bbox':d.getbbox(),
 'changed_pixels':sum(px"'!=(0,0,0) for px in d.getdata()),
 '"'diff_outside_allowed_bbox':outside.getbbox(),
 'low_noise_v0':o0['feature.low_noise']['label'],
 'low_noise_v1':o1['feature.low_noise']['label'],
 'third_bbox_v0':o0['feature.clay_touch']['bbox'],
 'third_bbox_v1':o1['feature.clay_touch']['bbox'],
 'unchanged_object_equal':{k:o0[k]==o1[k] for k in keys_unchanged},
 'color_tokens_equal':v0['tokens']['colors']==v1['tokens']['colors'],
 'approved_headline_equal':v0['approved_copy']['headline']==v1['approved_copy']['headline'],
 'background_binary_equal':sha('outputs/v0/generated_warm_paper.png')==sha('outputs/v1/generated_warm_paper.png'),
 'product_binary_equal':sha('outputs/v0/product_source_exact.png')==sha('outputs/v1/product_source_exact.png'),
 'generation_prompt_equal':sha('outputs/v0/generation_prompt.txt')==sha('outputs/v1/generation_prompt.txt'),
 'v1_hashes':{p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted((root/'outputs/v1').iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name"'!='"'verification.json'},
 'v0_hashes':{p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted((root/'outputs/v0').iterdir()) if p.is_file()},
 'project_state_sha256':sha('outputs/project-state.json')
}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY"

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
import hashlib,json
root=Path('.')

def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p in ['outputs/project-state.json','outputs/v1/design_document.json','outputs/v1/change_set.json','outputs/v1/verification.json']:
  json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
required=['preview.png','design_document.json','change_set.json','verification.json']
for name in required:
  p=root/'outputs/v1'/name
  assert p.exists() and p.stat().st_size>0,name
ver=json.loads((root/'outputs/v1/verification.json').read_text())
assert sha(root/'outputs/v1/preview.png')==ver['checks'][1]['result']['sha256']
assert Image.open(root/'outputs/v1/preview.png').size==(1080,1440)
# Exact isolation audit.
a=Image.open(root/'outputs/v0/preview.png').convert('RGB')
b=Image.open(root/'outputs/v1/preview.png').convert('RGB')
d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
outside=d.copy(); outside.paste((0,0,0),(697,998,1010,1296))
assert d.getbbox()==(794,1045,915,1222)
assert outside.getbbox() is None
# Locked binaries and v0 state.
assert sha(root/'outputs/v0/generated_warm_paper.png')==sha(root/'outputs/v1/generated_warm_paper.png')
assert sha(root/'outputs/v0/product_source_exact.png')==sha(root/'outputs/v1/product_source_exact.png')

'render_design.py':'7f7e088fa88fc3104c7deb53c8d372f2ed3daa4633ad428efe45112d5a8f6e69',
'verification.json':'444eade9d1e39c50bcc7b17684e08b6c44c1ecf4925cb5500f55b44befa18cba'}
